tools.name: find_candidates
tools.description: Use when the user asks to find, shortlist or source an engineer, researcher or scientist from public work. Input: a role brief, a job description, or a public GitHub repository URL; be specific. Optional location only when the user requires one. Returns up to 20 people, each with the public sources

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use after find_candidates when the user wants more on one person, or when they name a GitHub login or ORCID iD. Input: GitHub login, ORCID iD, or the id of an unlocked search result. Locked shortlist labels cannot open profiles. Returns one profile with recent public activity. Not a full career hist

tools.name: find_similar_projects
tools.description: Use to map the landscape around a seed repository, for example before searching for people. Input: owner/name. Returns similar open source projects and their top contributors. This is not a shortlist; call find_candidates for that. Read only.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Measured public-work source catalogue, counts and role caveats. Indexed coverage does not establish live search readiness.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_candidates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
